header.name: Circuit Theory and Devices
header.description: This is a 4 credit core course for second year undegraduate ECE students. The objectives of the course is to develop problem solving skills related to transient, sinusoidal and frequency-domain circuit analysis techniques. The lab component of the course will develop skills related to design, simulation, fabrication and testing of simple circuits.

outcomes.label: CO1
outcomes.raw_text: Perform AC power analysis for single, polyphase and magnetically coupled circuits.

outcomes.label: CO2
outcomes.raw_text: Apply circuit analysis techniques (mesh, nodal, superposition, source transformation)

outcomes.label: CO3
outcomes.raw_text: Use Laplace transforms and Fourier series for analyzing simple circuits and two-port networks

outcomes.label: CO4
outcomes.raw_text: Design, simulate, fabricate and test simple circuits

lecture_topics: Review of Resistors, Inductors and Capacitors
Basic RL and RC circuits (First Order Circuits)

Reading assignment, homework, lab assignment

lecture_topics: RLC Circuits - Source free series and parallel circuits
weekly_plan.tutorial_assignment:

Reading assignment, homework, lab assignment
Lab: Test the performance of the circuit
